question: A Clone enters as a copy of Skyshroud Behemoth. Does the Clone enter tapped with two fade counters on it?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it also enters the battlefield tapped with two fade counters on it.
expected.answer: Skyshroud Behemoth reads, “Fading 2 (This creature enters with two fade counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter from it. If you can’t, sacrifice it.)” and “This creature enters tapped.” A Clone that enters the battlefield as a copy of a Skyshroud Behemoth will also enter the battlefield tapped with two fade counters on it.
